label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 142
title: EPIC: multi-modal support surfaces (packs, model/kind selection, assets, media QA, cost, providers)
body:
## Problem / why
The backend multi-modal engine (capability packs, model/kind selection, generators, asset store, media QA,
per-unit costing) is invisible in the dashboard; users cannot see or steer it.

## Goal & value
Surface the whole multi-modal layer in the ProductForge dashboard so a media/IoT project is transparent
and controllable: which modalities were detected, which packs are on, which models (free/paid) were chosen,
the assets produced, their QA, and their cost.

## In scope (sub-items)
- D1 capability packs view
- D2 model & kind strategy view (+ override)
- D3 asset library + media preview
- D4 media QA results view
- D5 per-unit media cost view
- D6 providers & models management (keys/allowlist/caps + download cache)
- D7 multi-modal dashboard e2e (visual)

## Out of scope
Backend engine (see the paired backend epic BI-0185).

## Acceptance criteria
- Each backend capability has a visible, linked dashboard surface.
- A media project shows packs/models/assets/QA/cost; a text project shows none (no clutter).
